body:
Kanban ALLYCAT-000: 'maybe it starts as an in universe firm?' (founder real-time, offered a real marketing pitch for a hypothetical 'Ally Cat Security' cybersecurity brand). New lore/ally_cat_security_prospectus.md: the founder's own real pitch text, recontextualized as an in-universe procurement document a faction would have actually received -- deliberately real-world-cybersecurity-shaped in a setting that's never had cybersecurity as such, letting the pitch's own vague 'perimeter' language mean whatever the receiving faction needs it to mean. Grounded in the existing 123-hero compendium: connects to Shell Parliament (the real ledger/procurement faction this document's framing fits) and Jiangshi Syndicate (the real containment/binding faction Ally Cat's own pitch mirrors). Deliberately NOT committed to an owner faction, species, or on-screen role -- a real, honest 'maybe' left open, not resolved here. TYLER commit d4e01ff. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
title: ALLYCAT-000: real in-universe prospectus for Ally Cat Security -- first lore artifact, not a full faction commitment
